When Rasulullaah ﷺ got Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) out of the hole, his face was messed with the palm bark that had fallen onto it. "What made you do that?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked him. "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) submitted, "The same people who led you to me were the ones who instructed me to do it." Rasulullaah ﷺ then smiled as he started wiping Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA)'s face. Thereafter, Rasulullaah ﷺ recompensed the Bedouin for his camel.[^1]
Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) Plays a Trick on Hadhrat Makhramah bin Naufal (RA)

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Mus'ab (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Makhramah bin Naufal bin Uhayb Zuhri (RA) was an extremely old blind man in Madinah who had already reached the age of a hundred and fifteen. One day he stood in the Masjid ready to urinate when the people started shouting at him. It was then that Hadhrat Nu'aymaan bin Amr bin Rifaa'ah bin Haarith bin Sawaad Najaari (RA) came to him and led him to the corner of the Masjid saying, "Sit here." There he made him sit and urinate. As Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) urinated, the people started to scream at him. When he had finished, Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) asked, "Shame on you people! Who was it that brought me here?" When he was informed that it was Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA), Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) cursed him saying, "Take note! I swear by Allaah that if I ever get the upper hand over him, I will hit him most severely with this staff of mine."
After some time, Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) had forgotten about the incident when Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) came to him. At the time, Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) was performing salaah in the corner of the Masjid and it was his habit not to ever pay attention to anything else whilst performing salaah. Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) asked Hadhrat Makhramah (RA), "Are you still after Nu'aymaan?" "O yes," Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) said, "Where is he? Lead me to him." Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA) then led Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) to Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) saying, "Here he is. Grab him!" Hadhrat Makhramah (RA) then took his staff into both hands and hit Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) so hard that his head was severely injured. Someone then told Hadhrat Makhramah (RA), "It was the Ameerul Mu'mineen that you hit!" When (Hadhrat Makhramah (RA)'s tribe) the Banu Zuhra heard about the incident, they got together (to punish Hadhrat Nu'aymaan (RA)) but Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) said, "May Allaah's mercy be far from him. Leave Nu'aymaan (RA) alone because he is a veteran of Badr."[^2]
Ibn Abdul Birr in his Isti'aab (Vol.3 Pg.575). Zubayr bin Bakkaar has reported a similar narration, as quoted in Isaabah (Vol.3 Pg.570).
